thresholds.meaning: Deal score floor for Deal cực nóng urgency label.
thresholds.source_evidence: FLY-INTEL-004: Scores >= 90 combined with confidence >= 75% denote top 5th percentile price anomaly.
thresholds.claim_ceiling: Reserved for verified high-discount flights on reliable cohorts.

thresholds.meaning: Deal score floor for Deal rất ngon urgency label.
thresholds.source_evidence: FLY-INTEL-004: Scores >= 80 combined with confidence >= 65% denote strong verified discount.
thresholds.claim_ceiling: Guarantees second-tier deal label requires verified cohort.

thresholds.meaning: Deal score floor for Deal ngon label.
Deal score floor for Giá đáng chú ý label.
thresholds.source_evidence: FLY-INTEL-004: Scores >= 60 represent noteworthy fare or capped low-confidence deal.

thresholds.meaning: Confidence percentage floor below which deal claims are strictly capped at modest labels.
thresholds.source_evidence: FLY-INTEL-004: Fares with confidence < 50% are capped at Giá đáng chú ý or Giá quan sát regardless of discount.
thresholds.claim_ceiling: Prevents false-positive buy urgency on small or noisy samples.

thresholds.meaning: Confidence floor required for Deal rất ngon label.
thresholds.source_evidence: FLY-INTEL-004: Deal rất ngon requires confidence >= 65%.
thresholds.claim_ceiling: Ensures second-tier label is supported by >= 8 comparable historical observations.

thresholds.meaning: Confidence floor required for Deal cực nóng label.
thresholds.source_evidence: FLY-INTEL-004: Deal cực nóng requires confidence >= 75%.
thresholds.claim_ceiling: Ensures top urgency label is supported by >= 9 comparable historical observations.

thresholds.meaning: Minimum observation count required to calculate median baseline and percentile.
thresholds.source_evidence: FLY-INTEL-001 & FLY-INTEL-002: Statistical median requires >= 3 points to avoid degenerate single-value baseline.

thresholds.meaning: Sample size in comparison cohort required to achieve 100% confidence score.
thresholds.source_evidence: FLY-INTEL-004: 12 observations span multiple carriers and day-parts for solid statistical confidence.

thresholds.meaning: Maximum observation age for healthy live feed status (2 hours).
thresholds.source_evidence: FLY-UX-008: Observations <= 120 min are badged as live.
thresholds.claim_ceiling: Ensures live feed offers are current within 2 hours.

thresholds.meaning: Maximum observation age for degraded feed status; beyond 360 minutes (6 hours) fares are categorized as stale_only.
thresholds.source_evidence: FLY-UX-008: Fares > 6h old are never badged as Live and display explicit observed timestamp.
thresholds.claim_ceiling: Strict cutoff preventing 6+ hour old fares from masquerading as fresh.

thresholds.meaning: Maximum operational retention for observed fares in active snapshot cache.
thresholds.source_evidence: FLY-SEC-005 & FLY-OPS-002: Active snapshot tables purge records older than 24 hours to cold history.
thresholds.claim_ceiling: Bounds database storage size and query latency.

thresholds.meaning: Bounded backoff intervals for failed notification delivery retry.
thresholds.source_evidence: FLY-UX-007: Standard 3-stage exponential backoff for transactional notification delivery.
thresholds.claim_ceiling: Prevents downstream mail server rate limiting.

thresholds.meaning: Allowlist of verified booking domains and airline merchants.
thresholds.source_evidence: FLY-SEC-003: Booking URLs must resolve to approved HTTPS partner domains only.
thresholds.claim_ceiling: Completely prevents arbitrary or malicious external redirects.
